candidate.blueprint_topic: Pharmacological and Parenteral Therapies — medication administration / food requirement
candidate.educational_objective: Teach clients to take lurasidone with at least 350 calories of food to ensure appropriate absorption.

options.A: Take the dose with food containing at least 350 calories
options.B: Take the dose only on an empty stomach to maximize absorption
options.C: Food has no meaningful effect on lurasidone absorption
options.D: Take the medication only with clear liquids and avoid solid food

candidate.rationale: DailyMed states that lurasidone tablets should be taken with food containing at least 350 calories because administration with food substantially increases absorption. Therefore A is correct. The remaining options contradict the labeled administration instructions.
candidate.source_claim_supported: Lurasidone tablets should be taken with at least 350 calories of food because food substantially increases absorption.
candidate.source_document_title: LURASIDONE HYDROCHLORIDE tablets — Full Prescribing Information
